capture.final_message:
Unfold `Metric.IsCover` as the pointwise condition that every point of the covered set is within distance `ε` of some center in `N`.

- For the first conjunct, take `x ∈ s`; the inclusion `s ⊆ t` gives `x ∈ t`, so the covering witness supplied by `ht` also covers `x`.
- For the second, take `x ∈ s` and choose `x` itself as the center. Then use reflexivity of the pseudo-metric, `dist x x = 0`, together with `0 ≤ ε`.

Thus the result follows from monotonicity in the covered set and the diagonal/self-distance property.
